title: Pat Cummins’ $905,000 Moss Vale investment bought in 2017 sells for $1.16 million after eight months
summary_full: Australian cricket captain Pat Cummins and wife Rebecca have sold their Moss Vale investment property for an estimated $1.16 million after eight months on the market. The couple bought the 1920s three-bedroom bungalow for $905,000 in 2017. Previously rented for around $550 a week, the property sits on a sprawling 2,327-square-metre block in the Southern Highlands.
